item.title: CT firearms manufacturer Sturm, Ruger replaces three board members
item.description: Three members of Sturm, Ruger & Co.’s board of directors have retired and been replaced.

item.title: 🔒 Catholic retreat in Farmington offered for sale at $4.5M
item.description: A 13.4-acre Catholic religious retreat and conference center in Farmington with overnight accommodations for 60 visitors has recently gone on the market for $4.5 million.

item.title: Hartford HealthCare signs marketing deal as PeoplesBank Arena’s first ‘Founding Partner’
item.description: Hartford HealthCare has signed on as the first “Founding Partner” of the recently renamed PeoplesBank Arena, further anchoring corporate support for Hartford’s primary sports and entertainment venue.

item.title: 🔒 New Carmody Managing Partner Lahnin targets talent-driven growth
item.description: Fatima Lahnin has spent her entire 25-year career at Carmody, Torrance, Sandak and Hennessey — and now, as its new managing partner, she's focused on keeping others there just as long.

item.title: AG Tong issues legal guidance on how Connecticut laws apply to AI
